attr.title: RomM & SMB Client
attr.desc: A dedicated RomM and SMB game library client for the R36S and RK3326 handhelds running ArkOS / dArkOS. Directly browse platforms, scrape box art, download ROMs into /roms or /roms2, and sync save states with RetroArch over local Wi-Fi without needing a PC.
attr.inst: Extract the zip contents directly to your Ports directory (/roms/ports/ on TF1 or /roms2/ports/ on TF2). Connect your R36S to Wi-Fi to communicate with your RomM server or NAS SMB share.
